landing.title: {{name}}
landing.lead: An AI tutor for IB, IGCSE, A Level and Swiss school maths and science that guides your child through homework and revision, with Swiss Science Tutors' human tutors one tap away.
landing.trialNote: Prices per student, in CHF. AI-only and hybrid plans start with a 7-day free trial; cancel any time before it ends and you pay nothing.

ai_monthly.name: AI-only, monthly
ai_monthly.blurb: AI tutor and practice for all your enabled courses, plus a weekly parent summary.

ai_annual.name: AI-only, annual
ai_annual.blurb: The same as monthly, paid once a year at a lower price.

hybrid_monthly.name: Hybrid
hybrid_monthly.blurb: Everything in AI-only, plus one hour a month with an SST tutor and a monthly progress note.

ask_tutor_single.name: Ask a tutor
ask_tutor_single.blurb: A written answer from an SST tutor within 24 hours. One credit per question.

exam_sprint.name: IB exam sprint
exam_sprint.blurb: February to May revision plan, timed paper-style sets and three hours of tutor marking.

plans.limits: Fair use: {{monthly}} tutor messages a month, {{daily}} a day.
plans.unavailable: Prices will appear once billing is connected.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.intro: Parents create the account and add their children. Learners aged 18 and over can sign up for themselves.
signup.guardian: I confirm that I am the parent or legal guardian of the student(s) I will add.
signup.haveAccount: Already have an account? Log in
signup.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Open it within 24 hours to activate your account.

fields.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence works well.
fields.usernameHint: Letters, numbers, dots and dashes. The student uses this to log in.

verify.title: Confirming your email
verify.ok: Your email address is confirmed. You can log in now.
verify.retryHint: Log in and request a new confirmation link if yours has expired.

login.title: Log in
login.identifierHint: Students log in with the username their parent set, or with their own email.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.intro: Enter your email address and we will send a link that works for 30 minutes.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.ok: Your password has been changed. Please log in.

invite.title: Welcome to the SST Virtual Tutor
invite.intro: Choose a password to finish setting up your account.
invite.ok: All set. You can log in now.

twofa.requiredStaff: Tutors and admins must use two-factor authentication.
twofa.optional: Add a second factor to protect your account.
twofa.setupSteps: Scan the code with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or a similar app, or type in the key. Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
twofa.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twofa.verifyIntro: Open your authenticator app and enter the current 6-digit code.
